scope: Local exact namesake follow-up, 2 July–1 August 2027 inclusive, LV/LT/EE. This is a namesake research pass, not verification of name histories.

people.method: Reconciled every under-five profile with completed cached national exact-title discovery and country/prominence outcomes from rounds 117–126. No broad Wikipedia or Wikidata query was repeated. Searched 61 selected exact name strings in the shared private cache and followed selected professional/cultural leads. New accepted pages were fetched with the official source-cache tool and their exact names, roles and country associations inspected. Saara Väli and Ance Strazda reuse already cached sources. Sources remain working-file/provenance metadata, never widget citations.
